title: MCP servers and client surfaces
requirement: Bridge, inspect and configure Model Context Protocol servers and client surfaces without adopting an unexamined registry entry.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Review a specific MCP registry entry, such as punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers, only against a concrete surface gap; do not adopt a new server from a registry listing alone.
comparisons_on_record_where_every_named_: A 37-check lifecycle comparison of mcporter 0.14.1 and MCP Inspector 2.8.0 (list, call, stop, restart, forced kill and recovery): both passed 37 of 37; one ps-listing regression of mcporter 0.14.1 was recorded.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
